sha256_provenance: Locally computed from official ZIP after publisher MD5 match; not a publisher-signed SHA256.

split_policy.development: Derived from BEIR train; exclude train queries with exact normalized text present in test. Not an official BEIR dev split.
split_policy.test: BEIR test, locally frozen; not a hidden or model-unseen test set

chunk_aggregation: deduplicate by document_id, retain highest-ranked chunk per document

licenses.status: Search-source checked; component terms differ. Local preparation only; no raw-data redistribution or blanket-license claim.
